intro: Over the past three weeks, ZCyberNews has published 28 articles on credential theft, with AccountDumpling, APT41, and Bluekit among the most frequently observed threat actors. The campaign tracked as CVE-2026-33829 has been widely reported, affecting sectors including technology, software development, cloud services, and financial services. The reported incidents span global regions, Europe, North America, Bangladesh, and South Asia, with a severity mix of 20 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 1 informational.
